overview.title: 1. Data protection at a glance
overview.text1: The following information provides a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you use Jobtrail. Personal data is any data with which you can be personally identified. Jobtrail does not use any advertising services, does no tracking and does not create user profiles.

controller.title: 2. Responsible party (controller)
controller.text1: The party responsible for data processing in this application is:

serverLogs.title: 3. Server log files
serverLogs.text1: The hosting provider automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser automatically transmits. These are:
serverLogs.item4: host name of the accessing computer
serverLogs.closing1: This data is not merged with other data sources. It is collected on the basis of Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR for the purpose of ensuring a technically error-free presentation and the security of the application.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.text1: Jobtrail only sets two technically necessary cookies: a session cookie that keeps you logged in, and a CSRF cookie that protects requests to the server against forgery. Logging in does not work without these cookies.
cookies.text2: The cookies are not used for tracking, advertising or analytics. The legal basis is § 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG and Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR; I have a legitimate interest in a secure login.

applicationData.title: 5. Stored application data
applicationData.text1: When you are logged in, Jobtrail stores the applications, notes and watchlist entries you create on the server.
applicationData.text2: This data belongs to your account and is only visible to you. It is not shared with other users.

guestAccess.title: 6. Guest access
guestAccess.text1: When you try Jobtrail as a guest, a temporary guest account with sample data is created at login. Everything you enter as a guest is stored under this guest account.
guestAccess.text2: After 3 hours, or as soon as you log out, the guest account and all its data are deleted completely. Please don't enter real personal data as a guest.

localStorage.title: 7. Storage on your device
localStorage.text1: Your choice of light or dark mode and of the language is saved in your browser's local storage (localStorage), so it stays the same on your next visit.
localStorage.text2: These settings stay on your device and are not sent to the server. You can delete them at any time in your browser settings. The legal basis is § 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG.

rights.title: 8. Your rights
rights.text1: You have the following rights at any time:
rights.item1: the right to information about your stored data (Art. 15 GDPR)
rights.item2: the right to rectification of incorrect data (Art. 16 GDPR)
rights.item4: the right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
rights.item5: the right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
rights.item6: the right to object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR)
rights.item7: the right to withdraw consent given at any time (Art. 7 (3) GDPR)
rights.item8: the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR), for example the data protection authority of Lower Saxony (LfD Niedersachsen), which is responsible for me
rights.closing1: To exercise these rights, you can contact me at any time using the contact details in section 2.
